title: Libre OOP algorithm no data / missed signal
body:
Hi, I'm new to using xDrip+ but have it working well with a Libre 14 day sensor, MiaoMiao 2 and Samsung Note 9 (also sending glucose data to watch), the problem starts when I switch to using the out of process Libre algorithm. When selected it will simply stop showing any new data and show a signal missed message. Once deselected it will begin working again.

I'm currently using xDrip-plus-20190907-66c8a5a.apk.

comments.body:
Is this US 14 days sensors?

After you install libreoop does it show algorithm worked correctly?

No it's the UK version Libre 1 sensor.

I downloaded it and ran the create_apk.cmd but when I try to install the libreoopalgorithm.apk it says app not installed. I must have missed something out somehow.

Do you have Android studio installed?

I think that the issue will be resolved in a day or so. Are you using the new OOP algorithm?

I'm not sure if there is a newer one but the oop app says version 2bb4958-service-2018.08.26 and I'm using that on the xdrip version mentioned in the first message. It was working fine up until I changed sensor

I would not do changes with the primary phone as the chance of this working is small.
